title: row
description: One recording in the filing list (docs/23 §3.2): an item of `cpa filing ls --json` rows, the `row` of `cpa filing show --json` and one line of the export's data/filing.jsonl. Ids, times and states; at most 80 + 280 characters of display_safe text; never a path, the device's own id or a network. Every field is always present. kind, why, tx, env.link, intent and queue.intent are extensible enums (x-knownValues): a reader shows a value it does not know as unknown and keeps the row.

why.description: unfiled: a new row; orphan: a new row whose project is another Mac's key (see asked); no_text: the transcription failed or timed out.

asked.description: Only on a new row of the other-Mac group: the key pressed while recording, which this Mac does not know.

env.description: The Mac-side stamp (docs/23 §4.2): the name of the Mac that pulled it (null: it had none) and whether it was recorded while linked to it (null: not a word this cpa writes), both always present; null for older recordings.

prof.description: Reserved for the context profile (docs/18 v0.8); null until then.

project.description: The effective project when it is one of this Mac's keys; null otherwise.

tx.description: The transcription: docs/15 §3.4's recording state plus stale (no result 24 h after archiving).

text.description: The memo text, else the transcript's first sentences; null with --no-text.

clips.description: Reserved for voice captures (#52); null until then.

queue.description: The queue item handed from this recording; open until it is spawned or done.

allOf.description: A handed row carries its queue item.
Only a new row asks for another Mac's key.
